name: – Isabel Wiseler-Lima – After § 5 – Am 52
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2024
part_text: 5a. Rejects the idea of offsetting the suspension of US Agency for International Development (USAID) funding to human rights organisations, as such a commitment would lead to a further increase in budgetary expenditures for the Union and its Member States, in favour of entities, most of which make no tangible contribution;
